# `liber:midi-device@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:midi-device` package (`midi-device.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem MIDI devices - the provider contract a `midi` publication serves to MidiService.  A PROVIDER MOVES PACKETS; THE SERVICE DECODES AND ENCODES. The USB MIDI class module, and the in-guest fixture before it, deliver USB-MIDI 1.0 event packets exactly as the transport completed them - at most 64 to a batch, with the host time the completion became available - and MidiService decodes them with the driver library's staged decoder. The other way, MidiService encodes with the same library and a provider puts the packets on the wire as they are. No client ever sees or writes a raw packet.

## Interfaces

### interface `midi-device`

THE PROVIDER CONTRACT a `midi` publication serves - to MidiService alone.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `open` | `open(version: u32) -> result<midi-open, error>` |  |
| 2 | `endpoints` | `endpoints() -> result<list<midi-device-endpoint>, error>` |  |
| 3 | `start` | `start(endpoint: u32, receiver-generation: u64) -> result<unit, error>` |  |
| 4 | `stop` | `stop(endpoint: u32, receiver-generation: u64) -> result<unit, error>` |  |
| 5 | `events` | `events() -> stream<midi-device-event>` |  |
| 6 | `send` | `send(endpoint: u32, packets: list<u8>) -> result<unit, error>` | Put at most 64 USB-MIDI 1.0 event packets on a TRANSMIT endpoint, in order. ANSWERED WHEN THE TRANSPORT HAS TAKEN ALL OF THEM, so a caller that waits for the answer is paced by the device and nothing queues behind it; refused on a receive endpoint, for a cable the endpoint does not carry, and for a batch that is not a whole number of packets. |

### interface `midi-fixture`

The in-guest MIDI fixture's control endpoint. DEVELOPMENT ONLY: it exists on a development fixture bound to a QEMU test device, reached through PermissionManager in a development build for a probe whose policy row grants `fixture-control`.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `inject` | `inject(endpoint: u32, packets: list<u8>) -> result<unit, error>` | Deliver these packets as one batch on an endpoint that is receiving. |
| 2 | `flood` | `flood(endpoint: u32, batches: u32) -> result<unit, error>` | Deliver `batches` batches of 64 note-on packets as fast as the service takes them. |
| 3 | `lose` | `lose(endpoint: u32) -> result<unit, error>` | Report input on an endpoint as lost. |
| 4 | `withdraw` | `withdraw() -> result<unit, error>` |  |
| 5 | `republish` | `republish() -> result<unit, error>` |  |
| 6 | `stats` | `stats() -> result<midi-fixture-stats, error>` |  |
